pick.headline: TV Marti begins broadcasting to Cuba
pick.summary: On 27 March 1990 the US government's TV Marti began test broadcasts to Cuba from a balloon tethered in the Florida Keys; Cuba jammed it.
pick.significance: The station was part of the US propaganda effort against Castro; Havana called it electronic aggression.
